title: Batch Processing and the Beam Model: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Batch Processing and the Beam Model: Visual Guide

1. Same Word, New Job | deterministic partitioning from lesson 2 reappearing as key coders, salt shards and event time | the same rule keeps moving: the answer must be a pure function of the element, never of when or where the job ran

2. Fuse Or Shuffle | six pipeline steps labelled by whether they stay local or cross the network | producing a key costs nothing; only an operation that must bring a key's values together pays for a shuffle

3. Combiner Saves Wire | bytes on the wire for GroupByKey versus CombinePerKey as the number of distinct keys changes | what decides the saving is distinct keys per worker, not row count — and it only works because the operation is associative and commutative

4. The Hot Key Tail | worker completion bars as one key's share of events rises, with salting on and off | a hot key makes wall time the worst worker instead of the average, and salting fixes it only if the shard assignment stays deterministic

5. Four Questions Builder | what/where/when/how assembled into a runnable spec, with the sink requirement each choice implies | accumulating panes are replacements, so a sink that appends and sums turns 8 then 10 into 18 without erroring
